preamble: Debuccalization of the aspirated stop [tʰ] to [h] removes the oral closure and keeps only the aspiration. It is a regional Sinitic development: in the Northern Min variety of Jianyang, Proto-Min initial *tʰ became h- (天 'sky', 鐵 'iron'), and in Taishanese and other Siyi Yue dialects the aspirated initial of Middle Chinese 透 words is h- where Cantonese keeps tʰ (天 Cantonese tin1, Taishanese hen1).

examples.note: Xiamen, Fuzhou, Jian'ou and Shaowu keep tʰ (Proto-Min correspondence table).
The same correspondence holds for 炭 'charcoal' and 腿 'leg'.

examples.from: 偷 'to steal', Middle Chinese tʰ- (Cantonese tau1)

examples.note: Also 湯 'soup' hong1, 他 'he' ha1, 太 'too' hai1; Cantonese aspirated stops regularly correspond to Siyi /h/.

sources: Norman, J. (1988). Chinese. Cambridge University Press. https://www.cambridge.org/9780521296533
